tldr: The causal target is the squared Hellinger distance between standardized categorical outcome marginals, with unknown adjustment masses and propensities and zero outcome probabilities allowed. The central open questions ask for the full joint risk and exactly finite-sample honest-length frontiers on the same original-record experiment, and on that experiment with propensity additionally supplied. A proved clean experiment transfer now yields matching supplied-propensity and one-row endpoints \(k/(n\log n)+1/n\) and their square-root honest-length orders in the Han--Jiao--Weissman regime. Supplied-propensity and one-row consistency have the exact \(k/\log k\) threshold. The simultaneous unknown-adjustment diagonal and the HJW-excluded finite matching splice remain open.
